demand_signals.source: Indian D2C / curated home brands listing resin coaster sets
demand_signals.summary: Morataara (Rs 1,850), Vibecity HN Hues (Rs 1,599, 'only 1 left' per snippet), WoodenStreet (Rs 649) and Pernia's Pop-Up Shop (Think Artly resin set, $57) all list resin coaster sets. This shows the products are listed. No sales volume data.

risks: Supplier listing gives no seller, city, pieces per set or MOQ. Need a written quote confirming a set of 4, single-set drop-ship, at <= ~Rs 231 (29% of Rs 799).
WoodenStreet sells a set of 4 resin coasters with gold flakes at Rs 649, which is below the proposed Rs 799. Shoppers may compare on price.
Marketplace check not done. If Amazon.in, Flipkart or Meesho sell similar resin coaster sets well below Rs 799, conversion will suffer.
Resin can chip or scratch and may yellow under UV, and hot mugs can mark it. Do not claim heat-proof or food-grade without a test report (Vibecity notes 'not food grade').
Handmade pieces vary in colour and pattern. The listing needs to say so to reduce 'not as pictured' returns.
GST: 18% assumed (HSN 3926/3924 plastic articles). CA to confirm.
Not glass. Pack with bubble wrap anyway to protect the gold foil edges.

review.notes: Rs 799 has no price headroom: Flipkart resin coaster sets of 4 sell at Rs 670-799 (Vision Craft Rs 745/offer 670, Custogifthub Rs 759-799/offer 684-724; cached snippets, roughly Aug 2026, seen 2026-11-13), one listing at Rs 264, and WoodenStreet gold-flake set of 4 at Rs 649, so plan for ~Rs 649, which cuts net revenue (ex-GST) from ~Rs 677 to ~Rs 550. The Rs 220 cost is an unattributed IndiaMART snippet with no seller, city, piece count or MOQ. Need a written quote for a 4-piece set, single-set drop-ship, at <= ~Rs 180, plus real photos with permission. Make no heat-proof or food-grade claims without a test report.
